entry_rules.large_adverse_excursion: not penalized or excluded by entry label
entry_rules.partial_future: entire setup unresolved when any eligible candidate fails 90% future-price coverage or lacks exact deadline; the 90% criterion still permits some internal holes

exit_rule: EXIT iff current step >= the best observed exit step from the original entry. This is a past-optimum indicator, not continuation value at the current state.
